documented_probe: C-01d6c7ae (select model parameters that reproduce the reference full-physics state within a tight absolute tolerance): the covering task exercises the competency directly at medium difficulty; the verifier executes the fixed engine with the agent's tuning config on the visible case plus five hidden randomized two-body cases (perigee in [0.55,1.0], eccentricity in [0.1,0.7], horizon in [2,5]) and requires status ok, budget respected, finite state, and max componentwise error <= 1e-6 versus the engine's reference mode.
notes: Single-stage tuning task: the agent must experimentally select integrator scheme and step count under a hard acceleration-evaluation budget (euler/heun and coarse rk4 miss the 1e-6 tolerance on eccentric hidden cases; rk4 needs steps in roughly [150,750] so 4*steps <= 3000), and must leave all physics-changing knobs (drag, softening, renormalize) off. Reference convergence is ~1e-13 so the tolerance is meaningful. Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (budget/accuracy trade-off), adversarial_inputs (physics-change traps), hidden_case_generalization, and quantitative_correctness (tight numeric tolerance). No tool breadth, no dependency chain; totals bucket to medium.
